# Payment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Payment`](gmeow-Payment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Payment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A payment event — a financial transaction whose purpose is to discharge an obligation or transfer value. A thin subclass of [`FinancialTransaction`](gmeow-FinancialTransaction.md) distinguished by the [`paymentMethod`](../properties/gmeow-paymentMethod.md) facet.
